title: CPF Module Schema: NetApp Account module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-netappaccount'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

active_directory.type: object({ username = string password = string domain = string dns_servers = list(string) smb_server_name = string organizational_unit = optional(string, "CN=Computers") })
active_directory.description: (Optional) A active_directory block as defined below. object({ username = "(Required) The Username of Active Directory Domain Administrator." password = "(Required) The password associated with the username." domain = "(Required) The name of the Active Directory domain." dns_servers = "(Required) A list of DNS server IP addresses for the Active Directory domain. Only allows IPv4 address" smb_server_name = "(Required) The NetBIOS name which should be used for the NetApp SMB Server, which will be registered as a computer account in the AD and used to mount volumes." organizational_unit = "(Optional) The Organizational Unit (OU) within Active Directory where machines will be created. If blank, defaults to CN=Computers." })

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

customer_managed_key.type: object({ key_vault_id = string expiration_date = string identity_id = string identity_principal_id = string })
customer_managed_key.description: (Optional) A customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." identity_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." identity_principal_id = "(Required) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." })

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Optional) The identity block where it is used when customer managed keys based encryption will be enabled as defined below. object({ type = "(Required) The identity type, which can be SystemAssigned or UserAssigned. Only one type at a time is supported by Azure NetApp Files." identity_ids = "(Optional) The identity id of the user assigned identity to use when type is UserAssigned." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The Resource ID of the NetApp Account.

name.description: The Name of the NetApp Account.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Netappaccount' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
